about.title: West Covina Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Traffic through West Covina moves in layers. The I-10 San Bernardino Freeway carries commuters across the top of the city, while Azusa Avenue, Sunset Avenue and Amar Road handle the local trips to school and work. In 2025, public records show 409 injury collisions in West Covina, with 573 people injured and 5 lives lost. Those numbers are simply counts, but each one represents someone whose week, or year, changed in a moment. Reports also show crashes clustering on Wednesdays between 3 p.m. and 5 p.m., when afternoon traffic builds along the arterials. If you were hurt in one of these collisions, we can help you take the next step. Our team handles car accident claims on a contingency basis, meaning you pay no fee unless there is a recovery. We'll review what happened and explain your options under California law, from the two-year filing window to how comparative fault might apply.

whyChoose.title: Why West Covina Drivers Choose Us

items.title: The clock is already running
items.desc: California gives most car accident victims two years to file a lawsuit, but if a city vehicle or a road maintained by a public agency played a role, that window can shrink to six months. We can pin down which deadline applies to you before it becomes a problem.

items.title: Partial fault does not close the door
items.desc: Under California's pure comparative fault rule, you can still recover even if you were partly responsible, with your share reduced by your percentage of blame. We can push back when an insurer tries to inflate that percentage.

items.title: No fee unless you recover
items.desc: We work on contingency, so you pay nothing up front and nothing at all unless your claim results in a recovery. There's no cap in California on compensation for pain, suffering and lost quality of life.

items.question: I was rear-ended on the I-10 near the Azusa Avenue exit. Should I talk to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: You are not required to give the other driver's insurer a recorded statement, and it is generally wise to decline until you have spoken with an attorney. Adjusters are trained to ask questions that can later be used to shift some of the blame onto you, which matters under California's comparative fault system. Report the crash to your own insurer as your policy requires, and let us handle communication with the other side.

items.question: What evidence should I gather after a West Covina car crash?
items.answer: Photos of the vehicles, the roadway and any visible injuries are valuable, as are the names of witnesses and the responding officers' report number. Keep every medical record, receipt and repair estimate, and save the damaged parts of your car if you can. Many stretches of Azusa Avenue, Sunset Avenue and Amar Road are lined with businesses whose cameras may have captured the collision, and that footage is often overwritten within days, so acting quickly helps.

items.question: Does your firm charge for a case review?
items.answer: No. Our service is completely free. We work on a contingency basis, which means there is no fee unless your case results in a recovery. You can ask questions and decide whether to move forward with no obligation.
